io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.balance

Class BalanceOverrides

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.balance.BalanceOverrides

  • public final class BalanceOverrides
extends java.lang.Object
    Optional, opt-in per-addon score overrides read from a bundled balance.yml at the root of the addon jar. Absent file => empty overrides (the heuristic scores every item). Authors are never required to ship this. Format: 
     scores:
   MY_ITEM_ID: 85
 trivial:
   - SOME_INGREDIENT_ID
